releases.name: Road Layers 2026-11-06
releases.body: Created Road Layers, a test page that stacks cars from several drives onto one road. You pick two or more clips of the same stretch, line them up with an auto line up and a flip view, and build a composite that you can play and record. Clip videos show in their cards, and frames are now pulled with a built in video decoder that restarts after a crash and says which stage failed.

jobs.description: Road Layers stacks cars from several drive clips onto one road in the browser.

releases.name: Field Twin Violet 2026-11-06
releases.body: Added company parts, working and not working counts, and a Count stuff action for taking inventory. The company parts list loads in one tap from Setup, shows in the parts picker with kind and customer filters, and can be exported as a count sheet in the warehouse layout or imported back to set counts. Label photos now match the parts library, and one photo can hold several parts, each matched on its own. Added ticket tracking on orders, Undo for wrong history entries, a read only check link, and weekly inventory reports every Friday morning. Truck is now the default location for parts.

jobs.description: A phone inventory app for parts, vendors, reorder levels, orders, and storage locations.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-06
releases.body: The Field Twin Companion now draws the streets around you, sent by the phone from OpenStreetMap and refreshed as you drive. The companion shows up more reliably over Bluetooth and can also link over a USB cable. Team lockers shown without signing in now show only the locker, not who shared it or when. Info buttons were brought up to date.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: Cat Command Chat 2026-11-06
releases.body: Chat rooms now set up from GitHub with no phone sign in needed. Info buttons were brought up to date with how things work now.

jobs.description: A private group chat app with reactions, voice notes, chess, GIFs, and notifications.

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-11-06
releases.body: Order, lathe, and brake programs now resume when the game is reopened without a crash. After a power drop on reopen, floor machines trip their emergency stops for the crew to reset, and your mill boots before its program resumes. The crew looks at any machine that sits still and says why in a bubble, and says what they fix while they work. Lasers can now run out of assist gas. Checks for the finance minute and the machine settings line are steadier.

jobs.description: A letter shop tycoon built around a simulated knee mill that grows into a factory.

releases.name: Repo Find 2026-11-04
releases.body: Added the Resolve tab. Look up software by purpose across GitHub and Software Heritage, label results with a bucket, kinds of data and a plain description, load any account's public repos, and export. Added the Rabbit tab, where black windows fill with code from a random repo found by the stumble terms, hold for ten seconds, then refill. Every pull is logged, exportable, and included in backup.

jobs.description: Search and watch tool for code repos, archives, and sites.

releases.name: Tower Builder 2 2026-11-05
releases.body: Rebuilt the game with a light theme, a real truss physics engine, a level picker, undo, erase, saved builds, and a phone friendly layout. There are now twelve tower levels with tighter budgets, cables for guy wires, and twelve bridge levels with road beams and a truck crossing.

jobs.description: Second version of the tower builder game, with an info button explaining the rules.

releases.name: Retro Software Catalog 2026-11-05
releases.body: Removed Tunnel FX from the catalog. Labeled CoffeeKit One as a game and Coffee Autosim as a simulator.

jobs.description: A retro styled software catalog that lists the developer's apps.

releases.name: Threat Poller 2026-11-04
releases.body: Added routes for the watchlist, the catalog and site checks, with a schema file for the new tables.

jobs.description: Background poller that watches GitHub repos by category, saves alerts to Postgres, and serves them over a read API.
